name: Bank branch
summary: Freestanding 2,500–5,000 SF branch with drive-up lanes, canopy, vault, ATM and heavy security/low-voltage. Small building size and specialty items push $/SF well above general retail. RSMeans 2022 project data (national quartiles) are a solid anchor; specialty equipment costs are derived.

typicalSize.method: Judgment; RSMeans bank model uses 4,100 SF (e2).

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Derived: 3,500-SF branch on a ≈1-acre pad (drive-up stacking, 15–25 spaces).

perPrimaryUnit.method: RSMeans 2022 bank quartiles $300 / $335 / $415 (e1). RSMeans 2019 bank model $219.29–244.65 hard excl. site (e2) × ≈1.3 = $285–318, + ≈$40–50/SF pad sitework and drive-up lanes → ≈$330–365. Mid = $360 (2026) ≈ RSMeans 2022 median carried forward modestly and the model build-up. Low $280, High $480 ≈ 3/4 quartile carried forward. RSMeans model escalation 2019→2026 ≈ ×1.3, inferred from RSMeans' own office 2–4 story model: 2019 total $187.02 (open) / $204.43 (union) vs. 2026 national $253.63 (BD+C) = ×1.24–1.36. This is only used to compare evidence; the build script escalates from the stated dollarYear.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. building, drive-up canopy, vault room construction and pad sitework; excludes vault door/teller equipment/ATMs (line items), furniture, land, soft costs.

systemSplit.method: Derived. MEP from RSMeans 2022 bank medians (plumbing 3.39%, mechanical 5.1%, electrical 13.05% → 26 10% + 27 3%, with security 28 3%, e1). Sitework 14% for a pad with drive-up lanes. Architectural remainder by judgment (masonry 04, storefront/teller glazing 08, millwork 06).

lineItems.name: Vault door, safe deposit boxes and night depository

cost.method: Derived judgment (no public source fetched): modular vault panels/door ≈ $40k–150k, safe deposit box nests and night drop ≈ $20k–100k.
Derived judgment per lane: pneumatic tube system or interactive teller machine incl. installation.
Derived judgment: ATM unit + surround/kiosk + installation and security.

lineItems.name: Security: access control, CCTV, alarm

cost.method: Derived from _blocks/building-systems.json unit costs: ≈6 controlled doors × $2,800 + ≈16 cameras × $1,800 + alarm/hold-up system ≈ $10k–20k.

lineItems.notes: Often bank-vendor contracted, outside the GC.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived judgment: teller line/pods, offices, lobby furniture, signage-adjacent fixtures.

pctOfHard.method: Derived: A/E 7–8% (RSMeans bank model carries 8%), permits 1–2%, survey/geotech 1%, insurance/legal 2%, developer/PM fee 3–5%; prototype designs lower A/E.

softCosts.notes: Bank regulatory approvals for a new branch are owner costs outside construction.

design.method: Simple commercial shells: low design contingency.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Min ≈ $250 × 1.12; max ≈ $480 hard + specialty equipment ($100+/SF on 3,500 SF) × 1.2.

source.title: 2022 Project Costs — 50 17 00 Project Costs per S.F.

evidence.quote: Banking Institutions, Total Project Costs per S.F.: 1/4 = 300, Median = 335, 3/4 = 415 (Plumbing 3.39%, Mechanical 5.10%, Electrical 13.05% medians).
evidence.scopeNotes: Completed bank buildings, January 2022 national dollars, incl. contractor OH&P; sitework scope not stated.

source.title: Construction Cost Estimates for a Bank in National, US (2019 RSMeans data)

evidence.quote: Bank ... Floor Area (S.F.): 4,100 ... SubTotal 100% $195.72 ... Contractor Fees (General Conditions,Overhead,Profit) 25% $48.93 (union); open shop SubTotal $175.43, fees $43.86
evidence.scopeNotes: Basic-component model building, excludes sitework. Hard = SubTotal + contractor fees (open $219.29, union $244.65); architectural fee 8% excluded. Face brick & concrete block / reinforced concrete model.

evidence.quote: Square Foot Costs: Office Building, 2-4 Story — National Average Q2 2026 $253.63.
evidence.scopeNotes: Used only to infer RSMeans model escalation 2019→2026 (vs. 2019 office 2–4 story model total $187.02–204.43).

openQuestions: Vault, drive-up and ATM equipment costs are derived; a bank capital budget or municipal permit valuation would verify them.
